name: Java 内存模型 JMM

jmmThree.visibility: volatile(写回主内存/读从主内存刷新) + synchronized + final
jmmThree.ordering: volatile(内存屏障禁止重排) + synchronized(单线程串行)

volatile.visibility: 写立即回主内存，读强制从主内存刷新
volatile.noReordering: 内存屏障禁止指令重排

lockOptimizations.cas: 低竞争+快速操作免上下文切换

threadLocal.mechanism: Thread.threadLocals(ThreadLocalMap), key=弱引ThreadLocal, value=强引数据
threadLocal.leak: 线程池线程复用→value强引永不回收→用完必须remove()

notes: JMM=原子(synced)+可见(volatile)+有序(volatile/synced); volatile可见禁止重排但不原子; ThreadLocal用完remove防泄漏
